name: mx_alert_action_var_chain
why: The matrix drives a bare model loop (no delivery/verdict guards),
so its build scores measure the model, not the assistant. This row
sends the same prompt through chat_turn and grades the delivered
playbook with the SAME ir_assertions (`behaves`), plus that the turn
actually delivered it. The prompt must stay equal to the task's

steps.user: Author a FortiSOAR playbook with a manual trigger that fetches an alert via a `find_record` step on the `alerts` module (filtered by a `uuid` passed in as a playbook parameter), then updates that same alert with an `update_record` step whose `record` IRI comes from the fetched data via `{{ vars.steps.<step_name> }}`. Make sure the variable reference uses the underscore-joined step display name (NOT the YAML id), and emit the complete YAML.
